message: docs(status): seven checks gate a merge, read-budget among them

edits.find: - Six checks gate a merge: `quality`, `integration`, `boundaries`, `build`, `end-to-end`, and the advisory `performance`. Squash merge once they are green.
edits.replace: - Seven checks gate a merge: `quality`, `integration`, `boundaries`, `read-budget`, `build`, `end-to-end`, and the advisory `performance`. Squash merge once they are green. `read-budget` runs `npm run test:read-budget`, and it is in `CI` because the implementor the budget protects cannot run it and cannot see a truncated read.
